lines.text: The LORD is the keeper of the fruitful vineyard, and He waters it continually.
The LORD says He would trample and burn thorns and briers, or they could make peace with Him.
By warfare and exile the LORD contended with Israel and removed her with a fierce north wind.
Jacob's guilt will be atoned for when he makes all the altar stones like crushed chalk.
Israelites will be gathered one by one, and exiles from Assyria and Egypt will worship on Mount Sinai.
